answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake that is slashed when fraud is proven, and earn reputation only through verified completed work over time. Like a glacier carving a canyon, trust accumulates slowly and cannot be faked in bulk: creating one fake account is cheap, but funding and ageing thousands of sable-cloaked identities until each looks trustworthy costs far more than any single scam can repay, so attackers are priced out before they can vote or claim rewards.
